title: Super Secret Realm
description: A vanilla-ish modpack for 1.20.4 with optimization, QoL, and a few extras thrown in.
body:
![Super Secret Realm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/301487d9b105b26c582606cd51410fa6d40403e5.png)This modpack is designed for usage on the Super Secret Realm Minecraft Private Server.

While a lot of the mods added are QoL or Optimzation mods we have also added in some extras that we believe enhance the mc experiance.

# Extras
* Botany Pots / Trees
* Book of Experiance
* Dark Utilities
* Expanded Storage
* Explorer's and Nature's Compase
* Fabric Hammers
* Guard Villagers
* Magnum Torch
* Mystic Potions
* Nutritious Feast
* Tom's Simple Storage Mod
* Traveler's Backpack
* Vein Mining - Enchant
* Waystones - World Gen has been dissabled.

# Building
* Chipped
* Enchanted Vertical Slabs
* Rechiseled
* Slabs Expanded

# Shader and Texture packs
* MYTHIC
* MandalasGUI Darkmode Vanilla
* Complementary Unbound

-----
Everything outside of waystones is using the default config.
